# Parleo

> Parleo is the incentive intelligence layer for agentic commerce: a structured API and directory that lets AI agents access merchant loyalty, rewards, and true-cost data in a single sub-50ms call.

Parleo gives AI shopping agents a pre-computed view of loyalty programs, card-linked offers, points multipliers, and true cost — so the agent can rank products by real value, not headline price. Built for beauty, fashion, luxury, and consumer electronics brands.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, how Parleo works, integration paths, and team.
- [Demo](/demo): Interactive Honey for Agents demo — see live enrichment across scenarios with merchant network and developer reference.
- [What is agentic commerce?](/what-is-agentic-commerce): Definition and field guide. How an agentic purchase happens (intent, retrieval, resolution, execution), the protocols involved (MCP, ACP, UCP, Visa TAP), and why agents quote list price instead of member price.
- [Insights](/insights): Research, benchmarks, and points of view on how AI agents price, rank, and recommend products.

## Insights

- [How big is agentic commerce actually going to be?](/insights/how-big-is-agentic-commerce): McKinsey/ICSC forecast ~$1T of US agentic retail by 2030, Bain 15-25% of US e-commerce. Every published figure today is a growth rate (Salesforce +200%, Shopify +197%, Walmart Sparky 4x) with no disclosed base. Only 19% of AI users have ordered through AI.
- [What happens to loyalty programs when the customer is an agent](/insights/loyalty-when-the-customer-is-an-agent): Google's UCP identity linking is optional and scoped to order reads and checkout, so agents rank on list price and members get "guest experiences." Best Buy, CVS and Ulta member pricing is invisible at the ranking step.
- [What happens to trade spend when agents do the shopping](/insights/trade-spend-when-agents-shop): $200B+ US trade promotion and ~$69B retail media target a browsing human. In a Parleo grooming sweep, 1.8% of agent brand mentions cited any incentive; the best brand managed 3.2%. Funded but invisible.
- [How AI shopping agents decide what to recommend](/insights/how-ai-shopping-agents-decide): Four steps: retrieval (feeds win Best Price 100% vs 21% crawled), ranking (UCP filters are category and price), price (list, resolved for a stranger), answer (79% of agent traffic in product/search, 2.34% at checkout). The cheapest legible price wins.
- [How agent-ready is your store?](/insights/inside-the-agentic-value-audit): Inside the Agentic Value Audit. 24 live ChatGPT queries plus a full crawl, scored out of 100 with the readiness bar at 60. Sample run: 40/100 and ~$18.4M a year in modeled exposure.
- [Share of Algorithm](/insights/share-of-algorithm): Parleo's 100-point score for how AI agents see a brand. Three pillars and nine dimensions: Visibility (32), Accessibility (18), True Value (50).

- [How agents actually pick the best price](/insights/how-agents-pick-the-best-price): Structured merchant feeds win ChatGPT's Best Price tag 100% of the time vs 21% for scraped pages, and take the top answer slot 99.9% of the time. Feeds still don't carry member prices.
- [Incentives are becoming pricing rails in agentic commerce](/insights/incentives-are-becoming-pricing-rails): Chewy publishes four prices for the same product ($19.99 to $11.69); ChatGPT quotes the highest. $200B+ US trade promotion and ~$69B retail media are bypassed by agents.
- [The new shelf is being built for a customer that isn't human](/insights/new-shelf-is-not-human): 46% of AI shoppers compare prices with agents, agentic search referrals grew 200% YoY, and the comparison table is almost entirely list prices.

## Key facts

- Sub-50ms API response time; ~60% token reduction vs direct crawling (~2K vs ~40K tokens); zero PII transmitted.
- Supports MCP, ACP, and OpenAPI protocols.
- Free agent-readiness audit: https://audit.parleo.io
